name: 07643 · Little Ferry, NJ
findings: ZIP 07643 (Little Ferry) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07643 (Little Ferry) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
